notes.title: System Purge: Hollow Point Demo Available Now
notes.content:
The System Purge: Hollow Point Demo is available now during the Pixelated Festival Steam Event that will be running July 29th - August 5th. 

PixElated is a digital festival celebrating beautiful pixel art games. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems, this event will showcase a selection of Adventure and RPG pixel-art games all in one place!

[url=https://www.braveatnight.co.uk/pixelatedfest]https://www.braveatnight.co.uk/pixelatedfest[/url]

July 29th - August 5th
[list]
[*] System Purge: Hollow Point Demo will be live during the event.
[*] Actual Nerds will be actively monitoring your feedback in the Steam Community Forums, come talk with us about the demo!
[*] System Purge Director Jacob Vanbendegon will be participating in the PixElated Festival AMA
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the demo, and please consider wishlisting if you do - we appreciate your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2009160/System_Purge_Hollow_Point/
